messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — Acme is ready to sign for the 4-week POC but procurement flagged two things: invoice needs PO and Finance wants clarified billing legal entity. Also legal wants one DPA tweak.
Mateo: I ran the orderform with the POC SKU — price matches quote but note there's a small setup/license line for the evaluation license. Acme says they want that visible on the PO.
Priya: @Ava please confirm billing entity and remit address. We can route an invoice with PO number but need the final entity name exactly as it appears on their PO. Net30 acceptable?
Ava: Yes net30 is fine. Entity is "Acme Robotics, Inc." and PO will include PO: 98765. They asked for invoice to show: "Redwood Inference — Acme POC (Q2)" on the invoice reference.
Jordan: On the DPA: Acme redlined Section 5 (Data Processing) to add a subprocessor right they want; they also deleted our limitation on audit frequency. We should be okay with a one-audit-per-year cap and require notice + scoped audit. Suggest change: "Customer may request up to one audit per 12 months with 30 days' notice; scope limited to Redwood's processing of Customer data." Thoughts?
Mateo: That sounds reasonable and unblocks the POC. Acme also asked about retention of logs — they want 90 days instead of our default 30 for request logs. Impact on storage/cost?
Priya: 90 days will add a small monthly charge but for a 4-week POC it's negligible. We can mention it as an optional add-on on the orderform.
Jordan: Also, they requested we accept a PO-level signature instead of MSA signature for the POC only. Legal ok with a PO-level acceptance if the PO references the MSA version and is time-limited to the POC. Add clause: "This Order is governed by the MSA dated <date> except where a specific deviation is noted in this Order for the duration of the POC."
Ava: Great. Can someone prep a one-page orderform that shows: items, price, PO field, billing entity, and the DPA line about audit frequency? If yes I can route to Acme procurement.
Mateo: I'll drop a draft in here in a sec.
Mateo: ```
Orderform
- Acme POC (4 weeks) x1 — $0 (evaluation license)
- POC setup fee — $2,500 (one-time)
- Optional: extended logs retention (90d) — $50/mo
PO: 98765
Billing entity: Acme Robotics, Inc.
Invoice ref: Redwood Inference — Acme POC (Q2)
```
Ava: Nice. @Jordan can you review the DPA snippet and PO clause quickly? I'll hold sending until legal signs off.
Jordan: I reviewed — change the DPA audit sentence to exact wording and add: "redactions allowed for unrelated systems." Also add a short subprocessor list link instead of embedding.
Priya: For invoicing, we need remit-to details and payment terms on the orderform. If they want an e-invoice send to ap@acme.example and include their PO number.
Ava: They confirmed AP email is ap@acme.example. I'll add that.
DocuSign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared for Orderform #1768888888. Recipient routing: Procurement -> Legal -> Exec.
Ava: Routing ok but procurement asked if exec signature can be skipped for <$5k. POC total is under that. Can we set the envelope so exec signature is optional if PO provided?
Jordan: We can allow procurement signature as sufficient for POC < $5k with an explicit acceptance line on the PO. I'll add: "Exec signature waived for Orders under $5,000 when a valid PO is attached."
Ava: Perfect — I'll attach the draft orderform and DPA snippet and send to Acme procurement now. Will update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
